integrity: An explicit uniform mathematical proof uses the published nonequivariant homology theorem and a new equivariant cell-trace reduction. Both independent finite verification programs ran without assertion failures. No external audit or unconditional priority certificate is claimed.
limitations: Rational dihedral homology character for rank-two stable Kneser graphs with polygon size at least eight; no integral module decomposition, equivariant wedge decomposition, or statement for smaller sizes.
title: The dihedral character of stable Kneser independence-complex homology
